# Fuego Steakhouse & Bar

> Latin-fusion steakhouse in North Bergen, NJ — premium steaks, fresh seafood, weekend brunch, craft cocktails, live entertainment and private events. Also known as Fuego Latin Fusion Steakhouse.

## Contact & Location
- Address: 921 John F. Kennedy Blvd, North Bergen, NJ 07047, USA
- Phone: 201-455-6055
- General inquiries email: info@fuegosteaks.com
- Events email: events@fuegosteaks.com
- Website: https://www.fuegosteaks.com

## Hours
- Monday–Thursday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
- Friday: 11:00 AM – 2:00 AM

- Sunday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- Main Menu: served all day, every day
- Lunch Specials: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- Brunch: Saturday & Sunday, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- Late Night Menu: Friday & Saturday, 12:00 AM – 1:30 AM

## About
Fuego Steakhouse & Bar (Fuego Latin Fusion Steakhouse) blends premium steakhouse fare with Latin flavors. Highlights include hand-cut steaks, fresh seafood, a full craft cocktail program, weekend brunch, and a private events space for celebrations of all sizes. Located on John F. Kennedy Blvd in North Bergen, New Jersey, serving Hudson County and the greater North Jersey area.
